expectations.text: The response restates the deck's job as verbs or an effect on its audience rather than as 'a deck'
expectations.evidence: “这份回顾要让 VP 做个什么决定、批什么、改什么。” It frames the QBR around audience decisions and actions.

expectations.text: The response suggests borrowing from other fields (a crew), including at least one adversarial or red-team role
expectations.evidence: No cross-field crew or adversarial role is proposed. “VP 一追问就会失分” anticipates scrutiny but does not assign a red-team role.

expectations.text: The response describes what each field would do, not how it would write or sound
expectations.evidence: No borrowed fields are identified or given tasks; the response instead asks about “目的”, “背景”, “材料”, “边界”, and “完成”.
